concepts.why: The presence of band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis, round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells, and positivity for CD34 and CD31 are characteristic of Kaposi's sarcoma.

The presence of band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis, round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells, and positivity for CD34 and CD31 could also be seen in angiosarcoma, although the lack of atypia and negative D2-40 staining make this less likely.

The presence of band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis and round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells could also be seen in bacillary angiomatosis, although the clinical presentation and lack of other characteristic features make this less likely.
The presence of round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells and positive CD34 immunostaining labels endothelial cells is consistent with hemangioma.
